HomePage.title: Your restaurant team, working as one.
HomePage.description: Create a secure workspace for restaurant owners, managers, and kitchen staff.

Auth.asideTitle: Bring your team to the table.
Auth.asideDescription: One secure place for the people who keep your restaurant moving.
Auth.asideNote: Your team access follows their verified email.
Auth.signInDescription: Sign in to continue to your WhitePlate workspace.
Auth.signUpDescription: Start with a secure account. You can set up your organization next.
Auth.forgotDescription: Enter your account email and we’ll send a reset link if it matches.
Auth.resetDescription: Use at least 8 characters. Your other sessions will be signed out.
Auth.resetInvalid: This reset link is invalid or expired. Request a new one to continue.
Auth.verificationSent: Check your inbox for a link to verify your email before signing in.
Auth.resetRequested: If an account matches that email, a password reset link is on its way.
Auth.passwordUpdated: Your password has been updated. Sign in with the new password.
Auth.formError: We couldn’t complete that request. Check your details and try again.
Auth.providerError: That sign-in could not be completed. Try again or use email.
Auth.name: Full name
Auth.verificationPendingDescription: Open the verification link in your inbox. Once your email is confirmed, sign in to continue.
Auth.verificationInvalidDescription: Request a fresh verification email by signing in again.
Auth.organizationDescription: Create the WhitePlate organization that will own your restaurant teams and access.
Auth.sessionRequired: Sign in with a verified email to continue.
Auth.invalidOrganization: Enter an organization name between 1 and 200 characters.
Auth.serviceError: We couldn’t reach WhitePlate. Try again in a moment.
Auth.noOrganizationsDescription: Create one to manage restaurant access and invite your team.
Auth.teamDescription: Choose the email address and access level for this invitation. The recipient must verify the same address before joining.
Auth.restaurantScopeHint: Choose a restaurant for kitchen staff or restaurant managers. Owner invitations apply to the whole organization.
Auth.invalidInvitation: This invitation is invalid or expired. Ask the organization owner for a new one.
Auth.invitationDescription: Sign in or create an account with the invited email address, then accept this invitation.
Auth.verifyBeforeAccept: Verify your email address before accepting this invitation.
